Delhi Subordinate Service Selection Board (DSSSB)

DSSSB Various Exam Results | Cutoff | Marks | Score Card 2025

Short Details of Notification

Exam Conducted By

  • Delhi Subordinate Service Selection Board DSSSB Are Conducted the Various Recruitment Exam in Every Year.

Application Fee

  • No Application Fee to Check the DSSSB Latest Results, Cutoff, Marks and Score Card.

DSSSB How to Check Latest Results / Cutoff / Marks 2025.

  • It is very easy to download Delhi DSSSB Results / Marks & Cutoff.
  • The result of DSSSB exam is issued in two ways, the first medium is that the PDF of the result of the examination is issued, in which the candidates can get the information about their result by searching / finding their roll number in the said PDF.
  • Another medium through which candidates can get their score card / marks information along with the result, in which the candidate will have to go to the DSSSB online portal and login, to login, the candidate will have to enter his date of birth, high school 10th roll number. , passing year as well as the password which was created while filling the online form will have to be entered.
  • After login to the DSSSB online portal, the candidate will have to click on the TAB to view result. The result of all the examination given by the candidate will be seen on him, partner will also get information about the marks obtained in the examination.
  • All the candidates who will qualify in the said DSSSB examination will have to fill the E-Dossier Form, the information of which will be available to the candidate in the result/cutoff notice issued.

DSSSB How to Check DSSSB Exam Cutoff and Notice 2025

  • The information about the cutoff in the DSSSB exam is found in the result notice that is issued. Candidates can download and read the result notice of the examination to know the cutoff of the examination.

Enrolled Candidate Can Download the DSSSB Latest Result 2025.
